name: geocode
description: The exact boundary of any place on Earth, for your agent: look up a country, state, county, city, district or postcode by name or point and get its polygon as GeoJSON, list what is inside it, test points against it, merge several, or describe an area in plain words and get one validated polygon back.

defaultPrompt: Use Geocode AI to show the boundary of Berlin, Germany, on a map.
Which city and county is 37.8, -122.27 in?
Make one polygon for the Bay Area counties, excluding San Francisco.
